general.languageDescription: Select the display language for the application

startup.defaultImagesDescription: Show built-in landscape photos on startup
startup.customImagesDescription: Show your own photos on startup (add from photo selection)
startup.onThisDayDescription: Show photos from same day in previous years
startup.showOnHome: Show "On This Day" section on Home screen
startup.noMemoriesHint: Photos from the same date in previous years will appear here.
startup.noImagesEnabled: No images enabled. Default images will be shown on startup.

thumbnail.regenerateDescription: Regenerate all thumbnails (this may take a while)
thumbnail.useExifThumbnail: Use EXIF thumbnails when available (faster import)
thumbnail.applyOrientation: Apply EXIF orientation correction to thumbnails

grouping.burstThresholdDescription: Photos taken within this time will be grouped as burst
grouping.minGroupSizeDescription: Minimum number of photos required to form a group
grouping.recalculateDescription: After changing threshold settings, recalculate groups to apply new values. Manual groups will be preserved.

performance.progressiveLoading: Progressive image loading (show thumbnail first during navigation)
performance.progressiveLoadingDescription: When enabled, shows thumbnail immediately while navigating photos, then loads full image after navigation stops. Improves responsiveness during rapid navigation.

aiTagging.title: AI Tagging
aiTagging.description: Automatically classify and tag photos using AI. Tags are prefixed with ai:.
aiTagging.enableWarning: Restart the application after enabling/disabling for changes to take effect.
aiTagging.modelDescription: Select the AI model for automatic tagging
aiTagging.customLabelsDescription: Define custom labels for CLIP-based models
aiTagging.confidenceDescription: Lower values = more tags (less strict), Higher values = fewer tags (more strict)
aiTagging.minThumbnailDescription: Use EXIF thumbnail for faster tagging when thumbnail is larger than this size. Set to 0 to always use full image (slower but more accurate).
aiTagging.runForAll: Run AI Tagging for Existing Photos
aiTagging.runForAllDescription: Apply AI tags to all photos in your library.
aiTagging.confirmRunAll: This will run AI tagging for ALL photos in your library. This may take a long time. Continue?
aiTagging.enableToConfig: Enable AI Auto-Tagging to configure options and run on existing photos.

faceDetection.title: Face Detection
faceDetection.description: Detect and recognize faces in your photos using InsightFace AI models.
faceDetection.bothModelsRequired: Both models are required for face detection and recognition.
faceDetection.confidenceDescription: Only faces with confidence above this threshold will be detected. Higher values reduce false positives.
faceDetection.maxFacesDescription: Maximum number of faces to detect in a single photo.
faceDetection.generateEmbeddingsDescription: Enables face recognition and grouping. Disable to save processing time if you only need face detection.
faceDetection.minThumbnailDescription: Use EXIF thumbnail for faster detection when thumbnail is larger than this size. Set to 0 to always use full image (slower but more accurate).
faceDetection.faceThumbnailDescription: Size of cached face thumbnails. Larger sizes use more disk space but look better on high-resolution displays.
faceDetection.regenerateThumbnailsDescription: Regenerate all cached face thumbnails. Use this after changing the thumbnail size or if thumbnails are missing.
faceDetection.aboutDescription: Face detection uses InsightFace models to find and recognize faces in your photos:
faceDetection.arcfaceDescription: Face embedding model for recognition (512-dimensional vectors)
faceDetection.modelsNote: Models are from InsightFace buffalo_l pack (non-commercial research only). Total download size: ~191 MB.
faceDetection.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete the {{model}} model?

s3Backup.title: S3 Backup
s3Backup.description: Backup photos to Amazon S3 or S3-compatible storage services.
s3Backup.prefixDescription: Optional path prefix. Leave empty to use bucket root.
s3Backup.customRegionDescription: Use this if your region is not listed above
s3Backup.credentialsSecurityNote: Credentials are stored securely in your system's keyring
s3Backup.secretAccessKeyDescription: Will be stored securely and masked after saving
s3Backup.maxFileSizeDescription: Files larger than this will be skipped
s3Backup.enableToConfig: Enable S3 Backup to configure cloud storage settings.
s3Backup.fullSyncConfirm: This will sync all unsynced photos to S3. Continue?
s3Backup.deleteCredentialsConfirm: Delete stored credentials for {{provider}}? You'll need to re-enter them.
s3Backup.credentialsRequired: Please enter both Access Key ID and Secret Access Key

advanced.resetAllWarning: This will reset all settings to default values
advanced.autoReauth: Automatically prompt for Google Photos re-authentication on startup
